low_stock_threshold.label: Low stock threshold
low_stock_threshold.description: In whole units. Inherited by products that do not set their own threshold; a product's own threshold wins over this one.

setup.title: Your catalog
setup.description: Add at least one product so there is something to sell.

ui.name: Name
ui.importTaxHint: Some rows need a tax category before they can be created: either their CSV text is not recognized, or they bring no tax column at all. Pick an existing category or create a new one; the choice is remembered for future imports.
ui.statsWithoutCost: product(s) without recorded cost: the value shown is partial
ui.statsError: Inventory metrics could not be loaded.
ui.mvEmpty: No movements yet. They appear when you use Receive stock or Count stock on a product in Products, and with every sale.
ui.skuIdentity: SKU is the product identity: not editable
ui.errSkuTaken: That SKU already exists in the catalog
ui.errEanTaken: That EAN already exists in the catalog
ui.errCount: The stock count could not be applied
ui.errReceive: The goods receipt could not be recorded
ui.errDeleteProduct: The product could not be deleted
ui.errUpdateProduct: The product could not be updated
ui.errSaveProduct: The product could not be saved
ui.errAmbiguousAmount: This amount can be read in two ways: «{typed}» could be {grouped} or {decimal}. Write the decimals so there is no doubt.
ui.errNotAnAmount: This is not an amount. Type a figure, for example 12.50.
ui.errQuantity: Enter a valid quantity with no more than 6 decimal places
ui.errQuantityGrid: The quantity does not match the increment allowed for this unit
ui.errDeleteCategory: The category could not be deleted
ui.errSaveCategory: The category could not be saved
ui.errPrintBarcode: The barcode label could not be printed
ui.errPrintBarcodeNoPrinter: No printer is assigned to the «Label» role: assign one in Printing
ui.deleteCatImpact: product(s) will lose this category (unlinked; products are kept)
ui.deleteProdHint: will be removed from the catalog (soft delete; its stock movements are kept)
ui.taxNoneAvailable: There are no tax categories yet. Create them in Taxes: a product cannot be sold until it is known how it is taxed.
ui.errTaxCategoryRequired: Pick the tax category: without it the product cannot be sold.
ui.trackStockOff: Catalog only: sales do not move its stock
ui.previewHint: Tell us which column is which. Nothing is created until you confirm.
ui.previewMissingRequired: Map the Name and SKU columns: without them no product can be created.
ui.importCancelledNote: The import was stopped halfway. What had already been created is counted below; the rest of the file was left untouched.
ui.countNeedsQty: Enter the counted stock to continue.
ui.countNeedsReason: A reason is required to apply the count.

errors.inventory.insufficient_stock: Not enough stock to complete the operation.
errors.inventory.unknown_product: This product does not exist in this hub.
errors.inventory.off_grid_quantity: That quantity does not fit the product's unit: it is sold in fixed steps (whole units, grams…), and a part of a step, such as half a can, cannot be taken off. Enter a whole multiple of the unit's step; it is not rounded for you, because that would change what was sold.
